title: Final Fantasy XIV's New Tank Uses TWO Giant Shields
description:
Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold has revealed Bastion, a new main tank built around two greatshields. The expansion also adds Evolved Mode-only jobs, branching story paths, Auto Content Balancing, the Beyond the Lifestream raid and a 4 August 2026 Switch 2 launch.

Official reveal: https://app.pressengine.net/newsdesk/bastion/stories/bastion-revealed-as-first-new-job-for-final-fantasy-xiv-evercold
